posts.fact_source: FIP Reglas del Padel (padelfip.com, 12/2025): 6.4 (contact at or below waist, one foot on the ground), 7.1.d (ball hits server's partner = fault), 7.1.e (fence before second bounce = fault), 9.1.a (net + box counts as net only without fence contact)
posts.caption:
Padel serve rules: 5 quick calls. 🎾

Most players get at least one wrong – how many do you get right?

Send this to your doubles partner and compare scores.
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.q: Padel serve: how many of these **5 calls** do you get right?
slides.claim: Five serve calls: waist height, fence after the bounce, net then fence, partner hit, both feet in the air.

slides.label: Call 1 of 5
slides.context: You hit your serve at waist height.

slides.label: Call 2 of 5
slides.context: Your serve bounces in the box, then hits the fence.

slides.label: Call 3 of 5
slides.context: Your serve clips the net, lands in the box, then hits the fence.

slides.label: Call 4 of 5
slides.context: Your serve hits your partner at the net.

slides.label: Call 5 of 5
slides.context: Both your feet are in the air when you hit the serve.

slides.title: The answers
rows: At or **below the waist** is fine.
One foot must stay **on the ground**.

posts.fact_source: FIP Reglas del Padel (padelfip.com, 12/2025): 12.3 (return before the second bounce), 13.g (opponent's walls/fence before the bounce = point lost), 13.l (own fence = point lost), 14.c (bounce, then fence or walls = correct return), 7.1.e (serve: bounce, then fence = fault)

Padel rules cheat sheet: glass or fence – when is the ball still in play? 🧱

Save it for your next match. And send it to the friend who always argues about the fence.
Photo: Bruno Vaccaro Vercellino / Unsplash
Follow @fairorfault – your daily padel quiz.

slides.q: Glass or fence: **when** is the ball still in play?
slides.claim: Cheat sheet: glass and fence rules for rally and serve.

slides.title: It bounces on your side first.
rows: Then it hits the **glass**: play on.
Then it hits the **fence**: play on.

slides.title: It hits your glass **before** the bounce.
You use the walls on **your** side.
rows: Off your own **glass**, then over: allowed.

slides.title: The serve bounces in the box.
rows: Then it hits the **glass**: good serve.

slides.title: Save this for your next match.
groups: Bounce, then glass or fence: play on.
Your glass or fence first: your point.
Into your own fence: point lost.
